answers.answer: Roll one die per held office card, adding one per fatigue on that card; Chairman adds one more. Modified 1–2: nothing; 3–4: add fatigue; 5+: retire the member to Pensioners, flip the office card to Vacant Offices, and return its fatigue to supply. Commanders have no office card and do not roll normal attrition.

Only players who retired at least one pensioner select or discard one display card. Order is descending actual total retirement spending; ties go to most total windows including new prizes, then clockwise from PM. The acting player may peek at displayed blackmail. Do not replace cards while selecting; if display empties, skip remaining eligible players. Then discard all remaining cards and refill exactly three (prestige faceup, blackmail facedown). Return all remaining Pensioners to supply.

At phase start check whether opportunity marker matches the chosen main action: may take it twice if so, otherwise once. Move marker onto chosen action. Only the latest passed extra-action law may grant an extra action afterward; it is not doubled and does not move marker. With four vacant offices, Enlist Writer places one extra writer once this turn, so a doubled Writer action places three total.

After all family actions, while Debt and applicants remain, move the rightmost applicant into Court and reduce Debt by one; repeat. If Debt is gone, slide remaining applicants as far right as possible preserving order. Seeking a share paid the bank the queue-space price, not Company treasuries.

Fill vacancies in ascending number on card backs. Ordinary own-family hire requires verbal consent from every other player represented in that office’s candidate pool. Chairman election and Commander appointment are exempt. On promotion transfer fatigue to new card and insert old card vacant in ascending order. If no candidate or hirer is available, skip; office remains vacant and takes no actions, including hiring.

Former Chairman announces number of shares for a pure majority (more than half current shares). Any shareholder may campaign; first candidate supported by players controlling that many shares wins. If nobody reaches it, former Chairman chooses any shareholder, including self. If Court is empty, former Chairman automatically returns, using a supply member or, if needed, a prize and losing its VP; if neither is possible, there is no Chairman. Chairman piece remains a share for dividends, majority and scoring, but cannot be traded or invested.

Commit resources/cash first; Company office-check cash comes from that office treasury and goes to bank. Gather dice, apply penalties, roll and use lowest die: 1–2 success; 3–4 failure, retry if resources and office limits allow; 5–6 catastrophe, ending that office’s actions, returning officeholder to supply, returning fatigue and flipping card to Vacant Offices. Specific procedures can modify this. Do not take an action with no effect or chance of success (e.g. trade without ship or deploy without dice to cause possible officer loss).

May freely add up to three Debt, each adding £5 to Balance. Each further advance requires consent of players controlling a majority of Company shares (Chairman counts). Never pass Debt track end. Allocate all Balance to other offices’ treasuries, reducing Balance by each transfer; borrowing and allocation may be interleaved within limits. Existing office cash remains there.

Must spend treasury until £2 or less remains. Lease an extra ship for £2; fit a ship from a shipyard for £3 without owner consent; buy a Company ship for £5 only if no ships remain on shipyards. Put each acquired ship in any sea zone, including China once created. Extra ships return to supply at Refresh.

Declare home region plus only regions reachable through open orders with available ship capacity. Buy one die per £1 of President treasury; subtract one per declared nonhome region. A successful Trade fills up to one order per ship in that Presidency sea zone, without exhausting ships; first writer goes in home port, later orders extend this Trade’s own connected route. Writers from another Presidency cannot extend it; if writers run out, continue with filled-order tokens. Cannot fill another Presidency’s home. Gain Balance at printed order value, or half rounded down if a firm filled it this turn; President gets £1/order and each writer owner £1/writer. At most one successful Trade per President/turn; failed retries stay within its uninterrupted opportunity.

Target own Presidency home, associated region, or region bordering an associated region; never another home or another Presidency’s Company-controlled region. A Company target must have unrest or a closed order. Exhaust chosen officers/regiments for one die each and local alliances for printed dice; subtract target plus all other regions in its empire, counting target once (Company defense is zero). After every attempt, each owner rolls one die per officer exhausted in that attempt; each 6 removes that officer. Regiments do not roll losses.

On success take £4 per target tower plus faceup loot modifier, with minimum surviving participating officers in this attempt + 1 for Commander; distribute repeated £1 payout cycles: Commander first (£1 plus £1 per used surviving own officer), other families clockwise (£1 per their used surviving officer), bank last (£1 per regiment and per alliance piece), repeating until gone. Commander gains one trophy per tower. Then remove target tower/dome (if capital remove all matching empire flags), open all target orders/remove unrest, and on new conquest put loot token symbol-side-up above associated President’s box, Governor overlay in region, and only Governor card in Vacant Offices; no new Governor under Governor General. Move Elephant inside if it faced outward. Catastrophe returns half own-family trophies rounded up, Commander to supply; exhausted officers still check losses.

Roll current printed dice pool without penalty; after each attempt reduce pool by one regardless. Success gains £1, or £2 if immediately preceding roll failed, then choose exactly one: ship build stage, regiment, or Tax. Each unsuccessful roll adds unrest; catastrophe also removes officeholder. Build needs two successes total: first places partial ship in Governor region, later success completes it to President-associated sea zone. Regiment goes to associated President’s Army. Tax adds unsplit £2 to Company Balance or that President’s treasury; each Tax after first this turn adds unrest. Repeat until stop, no dice, or catastrophe.

Expenses reduce Balance £1 for each existing Debt, each officer/regiment in Armies, and each sea-zone ship including China; exclude Commanders. If short, take £5 emergency loans; Debt advances only while track space remains, but loans continue at maximum Debt. New emergency Debt has no current-turn expense; after loans set Balance zero. One or two loans lower Standing one, three or more lower it two. Compare remaining Balance with expectations under current Standing; if short, lower Standing one. Chairman may then pay affordable dividends at £1/share, including own share. If total dividend cash strictly exceeds expectations, raise Standing one. Failure at leftmost Standing ends game.

Resolve primary Crisis first, then secondary Rebellions in every other Company region with unrest, by Bombay→Madras→Bengal Army order; within each Presidency its Commander picks region order. Primary normal Crisis strength includes unrest in target; primary Foreign Invasion is just its attack die; each secondary strength is only that region’s unrest cubes. Associated Commander chooses/exhausts pieces equal to strength or as many as possible; if vacant Military Affairs acts instead; if both vacant Chairman chooses. Vacant-Military-Affairs/Chairman defense gains or loses no trophies. Equal exhausted strength means attack fails: remove all unrest and Commander gains trophy; if normal primary Invasion, remove one attacker tower if possible. Non-equal means attack succeeds and Region Loss; successful primary Invasion also applies empire creation/growth.

Support 0 or higher passes: place law among passed laws, PM takes token, resolve selected policy then immediate law effects. Support −1 or less fails: discard law, resolve dilemma If Failed if applicable, Opposition Leader returns token and takes PM dial, then new PM moves proposed policy one space either direction and resolves adjacent policy. After either outcome restore all used cards. If a law causes Company failure, finish the vote before Final Scoring.

In 1758 and Long 1710, at turn start before London Season, PM may call special vote if Standing and/or Debt on lined space, and must if either is on starred space. Use ordinary vote procedure/support threshold; no policy accompanies vote and PM may vote against. Pass: reduce Debt one per two current Debt, set Standing to S, PM takes passed-law token, activate firms. Fail: increase Company-share scoring value by Court VP token up to ±3 VP/share; PM remains in power and Deregulation law is not discarded. 1813 starts deregulated.

After Family share creation and before Hiring, form/invest until nobody wants to; managers resolve within-firm timing conflicts, PM between firms, then choose strategies. To form, only a player managing no firm returns an eligible Company share or flips workshop invested, flips family board to firm charter, places a family member as first share, sets value to leftmost and takes £5 from bank into London. Invest with manager consent by same contribution and bank-to-London £5. Maximum ten shares; further investments still add £5 but no share. Cannot use Chairman share; no Company-share investment if Standing and/or Debt is on lined space; cannot invest shares created this turn even if traded away. Workshops stay invested and lose bonus/failure VP.

Each firm gets one attempt/turn and needs a ship. Managers secretly choose trade zone/home port and London cash bid, or Hobnob; selected home port must be open when filled. Reveal bids, keep strategies facedown until matching Presidency begins; then reveal and roll one die per £1 bid, paid to bank. At least one 1/2 permits trade; initiative=ships minus successful dice. President’s successful Trade creates initiative similarly; lowest initiative fills first, President orders ties; if President vacant or never trades, firms fill after Commander/Governors, Chairman breaks ties. Fill open orders from home along own route up to ships+1, with filled tokens; cannot refill own order, may refill others’ (half printed revenue, rounded down). Add revenue to India treasury; each full £6 added advances Value one space.

Expenses cost £1 per charter ship plus higher of share count or firm Value; pay from London and/or India. If unable, dissolve unless rescued. Dissolution sends shares to Debtor’s Prison (−1 VP each), ships to matching shipyards, charter to family side; workshops stay invested. After expenses, manager may pay dividends from India only: each pays £1 per firm share plus £1 manager. Shareholder may waive any number only with manager consent too. Record total actual cash paid on Balance track; active non-Hobnob paying none records zero, Hobnob retains prior marker. Sweep remaining India cash to London.

Balance, VP and Vote tracks are unlimited. Components are limited; if supply runs out complete as much as possible. Cash, trophy/passed-law tokens, dice and regiments may use proxies. All information including discards and family cash is public except facedown blackmail and temporarily concealed firm strategies/bids.

May trade enterprises, facedown blackmail, family cash, Company/firm shares and promise cards. Cannot trade officeholders, writers, officers, prizes, spouses, trophies, passed laws, played blackmail, PM dial or Chairman piece. To transfer share return old owner’s family member and replace it at same share location with receiving family member. Played faceup blackmail cannot be traded.

Immediate transfers are binding; future-behavior promises are not, except a printed promise card’s guaranteed effect may be called if possible. Calls follow card timing/limits and none during Final Scoring. If simultaneous calls cannot all be fulfilled, guarantor chooses which. Promise card may be transferred to third party or back to guarantor. Transferred resources cannot activate twice (e.g. workshop bonus already paid this phase does not pay again after sale).

Use scenario setup cards. Deal player setup cards evenly, adding three extra cards for five players or six for six. Place every listed holding: cash/enterprises in area, family members in listed offices and matching office cards to owners, Company-share members in Court, writers/officers/trainees in indicated boxes, Commander in Army slot without office card, shipyard with matching ship in listed sea zone or on shipyard if unfitted. Each starting luxury gives 2 VP. Shuffle prestige and blackmail together as one deck; deal three for London Season display (prestige faceup, blackmail facedown).

Game ends after scenario final turn or on Standing failure. On failure during Events finish Events; on failure from legislation finish the vote. Once game over, stop negotiations, promise calls and blackmail unless card expressly permits final-scoring use; no negotiations or promise calls during Final Scoring.

Power counts enterprises and Company shares at their current Power rates (bottom two positions zero), plus passed-law tokens and trophies (+1 each), PM (+2), printed card power including faceup/down blackmail and applicable spouse. Award most/second 3/1 VP on turns 1–3, 5/2 on 4–6, 8/4 on 7–8. Tied first each get only lower award; tied second get none. Highest final VP wins; tie breaks by most windows, then clockwise from PM.

If Company survived, add current Court VP/share; if failed subtract that value/share and add 1 VP per uninvested workshop. Prizes/luxuries/spouse points generally recorded when gained/lost, not again at final. Survived: roll office attrition and retire Pensioners, no display cards. Failed: draw one random Company failure card and resolve. In either outcome, deregulated firm special retirement occurs after firm scoring but before Power or ordinary final scoring.

Spouses usually add VP, impose permanent restrictions and cannot be transferred. Make required enterprise/share trades immediately upon taking spouse. Retirement discounts can stack and are personal; each usable once per London Season and once during Final Scoring. Discounts reduce actual spending and prestige selection priority.

If shipyard returned because of Violet Effingham or unpaid tax, fitted ship stays in play. That yard cannot be purchased while its matching ship remains in play; it can be purchased after ship returns.

Enlist Writer: place member in any Presidency Writers box; with at least four vacant offices, one extra writer once this turn. Enlist Officer: place in Officers-in-Training. Buy Luxury: pay bank £4; gain luxury, 2 VP while owned and window icon (social enterprise). Buy Shipyard: bank £2; put matching ship unfitted on it (shipping enterprise, one vote and £1 bonus while fitted). Buy Workshop: bank £5; manufacturing enterprise, two votes, £1 bonus; worth 1 VP if Company fails unless invested. Seek Share: place member on empty Stock Exchange queue space and pay bank (£2, £3, £3, £4, £5).

If no family member in supply when placing one, take a member from one of your prizes and lose that prize’s printed VP. Applies to firm-share creation too. If no Family action possible, take none and return opportunity marker to supply.

When Court empty, former Chairman automatically returns, placing a supply member or, if necessary and possible, one from prize and losing its VP. If no supply member and no prize member can be used, there is no Chairman.

Chairman election by shareholders as above. Director: Chairman chooses current officeholder except Chairman/Governor; if all offices vacant, any writer. Shipping: Chairman chooses any writer. Military Affairs: Chairman chooses Presidential Commander, else any officer, else trainee. President: Director chooses writer of that Presidency or Governor associated with it. Governor: associated President chooses writer/officer in region (not Commander); place on overlay. China Superintendent: Chairman chooses any writer, hired immediately on creation. Governor General hired like Director. Ordinary own-family consent required from every other player in candidate pool; Chairman election and Commander appointment exempt.

May repeat Special Envoy checks at £1 treasury per die, no penalty. Success opens one closed order in a non-Company region or opens China by placing overlay/card and Chairman immediately hires a writer. After all envoys may make up to two transfers, each one writer or ship between any Presidencies/sea zones (China once created). Cannot transfer until done with envoys.

First up to two transfers of officer or regiment between Armies, remaining in top half. Then assign every trainee to any Army top half. Finally appoint Commanders when vacancy or another family has more total pieces than incumbent; choose among families with most pieces, place chosen officer in Commander slot and return old Commander to top as officer. Tie with incumbent does not replace. No Nepotism.

Each President chooses order of its Commander, Governors and Trade; Commander/Governors may decline. Each position completes before next; Trade can be before/after but cannot interrupt. If President vacant, Chairman sets order only and cannot Trade or approve local alliance purchase.

Trade does not exhaust ships. At Refresh writers on orders return to associated Presidency Writers box (dividers preserve affiliation); filled tokens and dividers return to supply. Fitted player ships keep fatigue.

At start of Commander operations, before Deploy, request President treasury funds for printed-price local alliances; President must approve. Put purchased alliances in Army top/active half. Deploy or defense exhausts whole alliance to bottom; strength usable once and cannot split across purposes. Refresh exhausts any unused active alliances and does not reactivate them.

Against own Company region, Company defense penalty is zero. For reopening orders/clearing unrest there is no tower and thus no trophy; with no tower or faceup loot modifier, minimum loot is surviving participating officers +1 for Commander, distributed normally.

Each successful Build is one stage: if no partial ship in Governor region, place it there; if one exists, complete it into sea zone associated with Governor’s President, requiring two successes total. Regiment goes in Army associated with Governor’s President; officer-like strength, loot paid to bank, no officer-loss rolls.

Successful envoy or Envoy to China law creates it; Chairman immediately hires any writer either way. Treasury holds ships, not cash. Shipping and Director may send ships there like any sea zone. Ships count Eastern for expenses/events/storms/laws. It acts after Bengal.

At most one attempt including failure; one die per ship. Do not attempt without export icon in Company-controlled regions. On success count export icons only in Company-controlled regions: Company Balance gets £4 per icon and Superintendent family gets £1 per icon from bank. No non-Company icons count.

On law: make all Governors pensioners, remove overlays and partial ships, return Governor/Director cards to box; replace Director with Governor General preserving holder/fatigue and ribbon position. Later conquests create no Governors/overlays; printed Company symbols show control. Skip Governor Elimination on region loss.

First add £3 Balance per Company region. May Govern repeatedly, paying £1 treasury per die, no penalty; every rolled 6 adds unrest to each Company region even on success, failure adds another unrest to each. Success gives £1 per Company region and requires one benefit per region: complete Company ship to any sea zone incl. China, regiment to any Army, or £2 to Balance/any office treasury except own, adding unrest to a Company region. Multiple Tax choices this turn put unrest in different regions. At most one successful Govern per turn.

Only eligible player ships in affected Company fleets roll: 1–2 nothing, 3–4 fatigue or sink if already fatigued, 5–6 sink; sunk returns to shipyard unfatigued. Company/extra ships exempt. China ships count Eastern; firm ships count their strategy zone; Hobnob firm ships exempt.

When order newly closes, return any writer there to owner’s supply; filled token flips to closed. If told to close in fully closed region, Cascade: close all open orders directly connected. If a connected order already closed, close that region’s northernmost open order instead; if none, it also Cascades. Each region can initiate Cascade only once per event tile but can receive multiple Cascade effects.

Normally location is back of new top tile in draw stack. Turmoil closes northernmost open order there, Cascade if all closed. Windfall gives owners £1 per writer on orders in top-stack region and every bordering region. Shuffle: Elephant March, shuffle tile into remaining stack, then separately shuffle discards onto top; if draw stack empty, March last instead.
Top-stack sovereign region gains one tower. Dominated region instead rebels with printed explosion modifier. March only if Elephant was fully inside a Company region that successfully rebelled.

If Elephant on border, open orders connected across border and add one tower to each touched non-Company region, then March. If Elephant fully inside a region, instead open all its orders and remove unrest there, then March.

Sovereign attacker’s whole empire strength plus event modifier must be strictly greater than defender’s whole empire. On success replace defender flag with attacker dominated flag; taking capital shatters whole defender empire. If attacker lacks empire, use free capital/star and matching small flag; if none available, no new empire/flags form. Failure removes one tower from attacker.

Compare only rebelling region strength plus modifier against sovereign capital strength; other empire regions do not count. Must strictly exceed (tie fails); success makes actor sovereign, removes its flag and closes all its orders (Cascade if already closed). Failure removes one tower from capital.

Commander returns half family trophies rounded up then returns to supply; roll once per officer in associated Army, each 6 removes it. Governor/card/fatigue/member return; remove overlay, partial ship and unrest. Restore dome with one tower (or Foreign Invasion specified strength) and appropriate invasion flag. Return control token region-symbol side up, £ loot side down; future conquest gets no loot modifier and region loses Presidency association. Close orders for Invasion Crisis (Cascade if all closed); Rebellion/Foreign Invasion already close. Standing loss escalates by regions lost so far this turn: first −1, second an additional −2, etc. Other Company regions are not automatically lost.

After successful Invasion Crisis move Elephant to successful capital (Imperial Ambitions); otherwise top-stack region. Company: fully inside. Dominated: point toward sovereign. Sovereign: point across shape-marked border; if neighbor already dominated by actor choose first clockwise neighbor not; if all are, use redirect-arrow border toward empire capital.

Storm die chooses targets: West Bombay, South Madras, East Bengal; all storms means each; no storm means top-stack region. For each target roll ordinary attack die then resolve Invasion/Company attack. Success closes all orders (Cascade if already all closed), removes target flag and all matching flags if capital, restores dome if Company-controlled, sets towers to half attack roll rounded down. March with circle shape only if Elephant was fully inside a Company region invaded. Designer ruling: unrest adds neither strength nor resulting towers; use ordinary die. Normal crisis Region Loss does not close twice.

PM must draw at least one. After one or two ordinary laws may stop or continue to max three; choose any revealed one, discard others. Dilemma forces its selection and ends drawing. Before vote, PM moves arm clockwise/counterclockwise stopping at first policy space matching law bottom icon; that fixes target/effect. Set Vote marker to printed support.

Tax: each family pays bank £1 per owned target; unpaid target returns to supply, including Chairman. Window tax additionally charges each window on enterprises and each family member’s prize; return if unpaid. Fitted ships of lost shipyards remain in play; yard unavailable until ship returns; losing prize/luxury removes VP. Bonus: bank pays each family £1 per target owned. Power: swap target marker with next higher; if already highest, swap any other pair.

Starting PM clockwise, each £1 family cash buys one vote plus printed card votes. Each card usable only once across all rounds of that vote; rotate when used until resolution. Adjust support; PM may call full round or stop after each, but round with no votes ends voting. Track unlimited.

Supporter may later oppose; once opposed cannot support again this vote. Track opposition; biggest holds Opposition Leader, tie retains current holder. With recipient consent, votes may be cast for an already-opposed or committing-to-oppose player and count toward their opposition. PM cannot oppose or consent to enterprises opposing, except forced “Vote with my enterprises” promise.

On final turn still pay each prize’s upkeep; unpaid member returns and lose printed VP. Negotiated help possible while game continues. Nonfinal Refresh returns writers to associated Presidency Writers boxes; filled tokens/dividers/extras to supply; reactivate exhausted officers/regiments; exhaust active alliances (do not reactivate); fitted player ships keep fatigue; advance turn and begin London Season. Final turn skips Refresh and goes to Final Scoring.

Each shareholder may retire one member from supply per London Season, regardless of firms owned. Actual cash after spouse discounts cannot exceed highest total dividend marker among firms they own; printed prize cost may exceed marker if discount covers difference. No retirement from firm with absent/zero marker. Otherwise normal retirement including prestige eligibility. At Final Scoring, after firm scoring and before Power or other ordinary scoring, each eligible shareholder gets one such retirement whether Company survived or failed, with no display cards.

Bank pays £5 per investment into London; trade proceeds go India. London pays ship acquisition, bids and expenses; India pays expenses/dividends. Family cash cannot transfer into/out of firms. Only specified procedures move firm money.

Turn order is London Season, Family, Firms if deregulated, Hiring, Company Operation, Bonuses, Revenue, Events, Parliament, Upkeep/Refresh; special Deregulation vote at very start before London. Firms investments follow Family share creation before Hiring. Managers resolve within-firm timing conflicts; PM between firms, then managers secretly select strategies.

Firm may fit from own or another player’s yard only with yard owner consent; pay £3 from London to bank. May buy a player-owned ship already in Company with owner consent: unfatigued £3, fatigued £2, paid into Shipping treasury. Firms cannot acquire Company or extra ships.

Only player managing no firm may initiate, so manager of another firm is ineligible. Obtain consent of holders of majority target shares. Move target ships, money, shares to own charter and copy both cube positions; former manager returns cubes and flips board to family side.

Managers negotiate with every shareholder’s consent. Highest-value firm primary; if tied, players choose. Move secondary shares, ships and treasury money to primary; secondary boards flip to family sides; players may negotiate share transfers. If primary exceeds ten shares, return excess shares to their owners’ supplies with those owners’ consent. Continuing firm keeps primary’s value/dividend track.
No bid, trade or dividends; still pays expenses and keeps previous dividend marker for retirement. Its ships are exempt from storms.

Emergency investments use normal Company-share/workshop contribution rules, even at ten-share cap (investment still pays expenses though no new share), and same-turn-created shares remain ineligible. Pay expenses, lose remaining cash, lower Value one space per emergency investment.

May rescue via emergency negotiated merger with only one other firm. Normal merger procedure applies including every involved shareholder consent. Other firm first pays its own expenses if not already paid, then covers endangered firm’s unpaid expenses.

All shareholders must consent to voluntary dissolution. Same as insolvency: shares to Debtor’s Prison (−1 VP each), ships to matching yards, charter flips to family side. Invested workshops stay invested for rest of game.

For each player separately, add VP from all shares across all firms, then round that player’s total down once; deduct 1 VP per own family piece in Debtor’s Prison. Applies before special retirement and whether Company survives or fails. Share rate by firm Value: 1 −1; 2 0; 3–4 ½; 5–7 1; 8–9 1½; 10 2 VP/share.

1710 turns 1–5, no deregulation procedures; 1758 turns 3–7, starts monopoly and deregulation may be voted; 1813 turns 5–8, starts deregulated; Long 1710 turns 1–8, like 1710 with deregulation available. Long 1710 often twice normal length.

1710: Standing £10 expectations, Debt 0, £3/office, Royal Protection, one regiment/Army, no Company ships. 1758: Standing £12, Debt 3, £4/office, Calico Acts, one regiment/Army, one Company ship East Indian, Bengal control token in Bengal Presidency. Specific map from scenario card.

Standing £10, Debt 0, £3/office; laws Military Oversight, Deregulation (Debtor’s Prison side), Calico Acts; two regiments/Army, one Company ship/sea zone. Put +2/−2 share value token in Court, create China, place control tokens in Bombay/Madras/Bengal Presidencies, return Governor General law to box and overlay over Director. Use Governor General instead of Director and no Governors. Copy exact map from card.
Final turn 1–3: first/second 3/1 VP; 4–6: 5/2; 7–8: 8/4. Tied first group receives only lower award each; no other award. (Tied second receive none.)

Starting Power: Social 2, Company shares 1, Shipping and Manufacturing 0. Expectations line £4/6/8/10/12/14/16; S reset space above £10. In 1758/Long 1710, lined Standing £4/6/8 or Debt 5/6/7/8 allows PM to call vote; starred Standing £4 or Debt 8 makes it mandatory.

Unrest does not add to Foreign Invasion primary attack or resulting tower strength. Use ordinary die for attack and halving towers. Event closes all target orders once; if already all closed, Cascade. Region Loss does not close a second time; its extra closure applies only normal Invasion Crisis.

Mercantile/Diplomatic Connection reducing check to zero dice means failure. Company Fraud at start of Revenue: roll one die per officeholder; reduce Balance by twice highest (minimum zero), bank pays cash equal to actual Balance removed, never overdraw Balance. Public Demands Impeachment returns member to supply and card to vacancies. Military Oversight demotes one Commander to officer, then appoints Commander from officers; same former Commander remains eligible.

Shared setup: Balance £5, family VP zero; local alliances in named Army boxes; loot tokens money-side up in matching regions. Choose scenario setup card for Standing, Debt, treasury, laws, regiments, ships and India political map; set Turn marker to its starting date and PM dial arm to matching date. Exact map and Elephant from scenario card.

Normal order: London Season → Family → Firms if deregulated → Hiring → Company Operation → Bonuses → Revenue → Events in India → Parliament → Upkeep/Refresh. Special Deregulation vote, when relevant, is at very start before London Season. Skip London Season on first game turn.

If Chairman office vacant, former Chairman leads; otherwise Chairman, then clockwise. Each may retire each pensioner to prize, pay printed cost (discounts may apply), move member to prize and gain VP. Keep actual spending aside until London Season ends to set card-selection priority, then pay bank. Unused pensioners do not stay another turn.
Whenever an empire loses its last dominated region, remove surviving capital’s starred flag; it ceases to be an empire. Applies regardless of cause, including Rebellion or Company conquest.
At Value 1 each share −1 VP; 2 = 0; 3–4 = ½; 5–7 = 1; 8–9 = 1½; 10 = 2 VP.

Chairman title holder acts first, then clockwise. After all Family actions, resolve New Company Shares: while Debt and applicants remain move rightmost applicant into Court, lowering Debt each time; if no Debt, slide remaining applicants right preserving order.

Operate red ribbon: Chairman → Director of Trade or Governor General → Manager of Shipping → Military Affairs → Bombay → Madras → Bengal → China if created. Skip vacant offices. Within each Presidency President chooses order of Commander, Governors, Trade; each completes before next. Newly created offices normally await later Hiring, except China hired immediately.

Roll storm die first; it specifies affected zones and number of events. Resolve required storms before events. Three storms means check all zones; no storm indication means none. Company/extra ships exempt; eligible player ships in affected fleets roll once each; China is Eastern, firm ships use strategy zone, Hobnob exempt. Then flip and resolve tiles one at a time for count on die.

For ordinary Elephant-located Crisis, tail identifies acting/attacking region and head target. Sovereign actor (large capital flag or unflagged dome) means Invasion; dominated actor (small flag or no dome) means Rebellion against sovereign. Elephant wholly inside Company region means Rebellion against Company. Foreign Invasion uses own location procedure.
